resources.string: Version %1$s is downloaded and checked. Your data stays.
Android asks once whether Food diary may install its own updates. Turn on \"Allow from this source\", then come back.
The download didn\'t match the new version, so it was thrown away. Nothing was installed.
The home computer can\'t be reached. Is the phone on the home Wi-Fi, and is the update server running on the computer?
That address isn\'t on the home network. Updates only come from the computer at home.
The home computer answered, but has no update file yet.
That doesn\'t look like an address. For example 192.168.178.67
New versions come from the computer at home, over your own Wi-Fi. Nothing goes over the internet.
